assets.name: probe-runde
assets.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: one small illustration for the German "Probe-Runde" breathing-practice button, displayed above a separate HTML label in a dark sage interface.
Primary request: a beautiful, exceptionally clear text-free flat infographic of learning box breathing: a simple cream pair of lungs in the center, surrounded by a spacious clockwise rounded-square breathing loop. Four understated arrowheads, one per edge, express four phases; a few short sage breath strokes near the lungs.
Style: restrained editorial vector art, geometric, soft rounded ends, bold clean silhouettes and smooth broad lines, two flat opaque colors only: muted sage #a9b99a and warm cream #e9ebe3. No gradients, shading, glows, texture or thin tiny details. Strong separation between lungs and surrounding loop.
Composition: square 1024x1024 canvas, centered, balanced, artwork inside the middle 80 percent with generous transparent padding; simple enough to stay recognizable at 90px. No frame or background.
Text: none. No letters, words, numbers, labels, branding, watermark, hearts or medical symbols. This is a neutral breathing-practice diagram, no health claims.
Background: genuinely transparent, not white and not a checkerboard. Designed to sit on #131712.
This is the first of two matching illustrations; use confident clean shapes suitable for subsequent real SVG path tracing.

assets.name: haupt-runde
assets.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: one small illustration for the German "Haupt-Runde" breathing-session button, displayed above a separate HTML label in an existing dark sage interface.
Primary request: a clear text-free infographic showing the session's TWO successive stages: a gentle natural-breathing sine wave on the left, then a short simple right-facing arrow in the middle, then a four-phase rounded-square breathing loop on the right. Inside the square is a tiny simple cream pair of lungs. The whole arrangement is one harmonious centered horizontal infographic. Exactly one full smooth sine-wave period, a separate arrow, and one clockwise square loop with four arrowheads.
Style: restrained editorial vector art, geometric, soft rounded ends, bold clean silhouettes and smooth broad lines. Two flat opaque colors only: muted sage #a9b99a for the wave and loop, warm cream #e9ebe3 for the transition arrow and lungs. Strictly solid flat fills. No gradients, shading, glows, texture, speckles, tiny details or thin strokes.
Composition: square 1024x1024 canvas with an optically centered horizontal composition occupying approximately 80% width and 55% height; generous transparent margins. Large, simple symbols readable at a total width of 120 pixels. Keep wave, arrow, and loop separated without overlap.
Text: none. No letters, words, numbers, labels, title, branding, watermark, clocks, hearts or medical symbols. No health claims.
Background: genuinely transparent, clean empty transparent negative space, not white and not a checkerboard. Intended to sit on #131712.
This is part of a matched pair of breathing infographics using sage and cream, suitable for subsequent real SVG path tracing.

conversion.normalization: Fit the source alpha>=180 bounds within 224x144, preserving aspect ratio, centered at (120,80). Classify opaque pixels by nearest RGB palette color before tracing; leave source PNGs intact.
